create.name: Eva Dalak
create.bio:
Eva Dalak is a peace activator — a trauma-informed transformation catalyst who has spent more than twenty-five years proving, in the hardest places on Earth, that the healing of the world begins in the healing of the body. Working across twenty-two conflict zones with international organisations, Eva bridges the personal and the political through somatic wisdom: her conviction, distilled into a single line, is that “true peace isn’t the absence of conflict — it’s a nervous system that feels safe enough to stay present during differences. Heal your trauma, heal the world.” As co-founder of Peace Activation, she has translated that quarter-century of frontline experience into a living methodology of courses, immersions, and community, teaching individuals, organisations — and nations — to move from reactive patterns to conscious creation.

Her memoir, Dancing in the Dark: How I Found My True Vision for Peace (2025), carries the most extraordinary sentence of her story: “Little did I know that I would have to lose my literal vision to regain a true vision of peace.” It is the account of a professional peacemaker brought to her own inner frontline — losing her sight, and finding in that darkness the embodied peace she had spent her career pursuing in the world. Through her Peace Activation Podcast, her writing, her speaking, and her one-to-one empowerment coaching, Eva offers seekers something rare on any platform: the voice of someone who has tested inner work against war, and found that it holds.

books.title: Dancing in the Dark: How I Found My True Vision for Peace
books.author: Eva Dalak
books.description: When Eva Dalak lost her sight for two years, a lifelong peacemaker was brought to her own inner frontline: trauma, belonging and the ancestral pain of a Palestinian woman raised in Israel. With honesty and poetic grace, she traces her path from disorientation to wholeness and discovers the embodied, soul-rooted peace she had pursued in war zones around the world. It’s a luminous memoir for anyone who believes healing the world begins with healing ourselves.

courses.title: Peace Activation Foundations Training
courses.description: A seven-week live introduction to the Peace Activation methodology, taught by its creator Eva Dalak. It covers all five Peace Activation pillars and gives you practical tools for staying grounded and present through conflict in daily life. Community access and session recordings are included.

courses.title: 1-Year Peace Activation Certification
courses.description: A year-long, cohort-based training to lead and facilitate the Peace Activation methodology, online and in person. It includes weekly three-hour live sessions, peer practice pods, a personal “Sacred Yes” project in your chosen community, and a seven-day in-person immersion (priced separately). Graduates earn the Certified Peace Activator Level 1 credential.

courses.title: Peace Activation Private Certification
courses.description: The full Peace Activation certification, delivered privately, compressed and personalised to your context and goals. It’s limited to five people a year, and applications are reviewed individually after a discovery call with Eva.

courses.title: Embodied Peace & Conflict Mastery Immersion (Greece)
courses.description: An advanced six-night residential immersion at Zen Rocks in Mani, Greece, for facilitators, coaches and NGO and movement leaders. Days combine meditation, somatic movement, live relational practice and conflict-transformation workshops, with meals and lodging included. Next dates to be announced.
